user.description: Gabriel Silva is at the forefront of Artificial Intelligence as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, focusing on the development and optimization of Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous agent architectures. In his daily work, he leads projects centered on model alignment, high-performance inference, and the integration of complex agentic workflows in large-scale production environments. He combines a strong foundation in applied research with robust systems engineering to tackle critical challenges in latency, accuracy, and scalability within one of modern technology's most competitive and innovative ecosystems.
